limits.description: All 135 labels and ordinals have original-PE constructor and sequential loader evidence for this package. Live opened-resource resolution and draw use remain unobserved.
No RDEF chunks in any of 16,044 programs. Original variable, resource and buffer names cannot be recovered from these package bytes; declared slots and signatures are available.
Technique identifiers and their bits are inventoried; native pass selectors, VS/PS masking, resource bindings, and runtime active states are not established by package inventory.
Every program has a verified private disassembly and public structural instruction footprint. Footprints do not replace complete symbolic equations, branch conditions, or parameter producer traces.
No retail Windows frame or GPU capture was performed. Package presence does not establish pass order, execution, INI activation, sampler state, resource format, or color space.

Catalog covers the selected shaders011.fxp completely. embedded-shaders.json separately catalogs 57 structurally bounded PE occurrences. Other generated, loose, fallback, vendor or version-specific code remains outside this inventory.

registry_schema.constant_accesses_limit: Operand occurrences count static instructions, not runtime executions. Dynamic expressions require runtime register values. Component masks union all referenced operands; they do not prove every component influences an output.
registry_schema.profile_resolution: Each program bytecode_sha256 resolves profiles_by_bytecode_sha256. Its *_id fields resolve registries of the matching name. Registry IDs are the first 16 hex characters of SHA-256 over canonical JSON; collision equality is checked.

scope: Complete static inventory of the selected retail shaders011.fxp package
